eos_records.label: lattice parameter by Haines and Leger,1997, intensity by Ono et al., 2000
eos_records.notes: Ono et al. report the extrapolated zero-pressure EoS values V0 = 130.6 +/- 3.0 A^3, K0 = 252 +/- 28 GPa, and K0' = 3.5 +/- 2.2. The lattice and phase lines in this file are a measured 48 GPa pattern, not the zero-pressure cell.
